purpose: Teach: 東方/長寿/祈願/武術/癒す/ユートピア/迷信/懐中

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、東方神起のファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, you know that customer? Apparently he's a Tohoshinki fan.
lines.style: Hushed conspiratorial lean-in, café-gossip soft; a little smile audible on the band's name.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、長寿食材に拘ってらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And he's really particular about longevity foods, you know, Mei-chan.
lines.style: Warm unhurried reply over the counter; gentle delight in a regular's quirks, melodic finish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、神社で祈願された後にご来店だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he'd come straight from offering a prayer at the shrine before stopping in.
lines.style: Soft storytelling lilt, savoring the detail; slight slow-down on the shrine, eyes widening.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、伝統武術の道場に通ってらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He apparently trains at a traditional martial arts dojo too, Mei-chan.
lines.style: Brightening delivery, small impressed lift mid-line; sharing the discovery like a gift.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「コーヒーが心を癒す」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he told me 'coffee heals the heart,' you know.
lines.style: Quieter, touched delivery; slowing tenderly through the quote, letting it hang a moment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ユートピア小説のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He even told me all about a utopian novel, Mei-chan.
lines.style: Light delighted energy, faster and warmer; a soft laugh tucked under the first words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、地元の迷信について話して下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he shared some of the local superstitions with me too.
lines.style: Playful hushed intrigue, leaning closer; a curious upward tilt at the end of the line.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、懐中時計を取り出してご覧になられたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And then he took out a pocket watch and just gazed at it, Mei-chan.
lines.style: Slow wistful close, voice softening to nearly a sigh; the image lingering after the words.
